dataset: Existing local IBM AML reference; no download/copy/regeneration
selection_data: August only; September dataset never loaded
clip_selection: Nonprivate training-only max rounded up to half unit; fixed before private screening
primary_selection: Fixed final scheduled round; never round zero. Do not relabel a favorable intermediate result as primary.
secondary: Best intermediate August round is descriptive, with all scheduled rounds charged. Old screening checkpoints were final-only; a reported best intermediate metric does not imply its checkpoint was retained.
confirmation_rule: Confirm every warm point from near-zero through the useful boundary on both other seeds; clear degradation at m=0.1 does not require three-seed confirmation
from_scratch: Nonprivate baseline and m=0.001 distributed DP, full 16 rounds and all three model seeds
comparators: Global-RNG harmonized research reference; per-client nonprivate mean; secure mean m=0; central DP m=0.001; Option A m=0.001
noise_entropy: Independent production OS entropy; no Gaussian seed is released. Each seed/candidate gets one noise draw sequence; no rerunning to select a favorable noise realization.
accounting: Every private candidate and model seed composes on the same data. Per-run epsilon and total private-search composition are both reported. Nonprivate references/calibration invalidate a finite-DP guarantee for the complete research bundle.
limitations: A finite bounded sweep can establish failure to reach 0.85 within that sweep; it cannot prove that all possible noise levels/trainers/configurations are mathematically incapable of reaching it. No such universal claim will be made.
